title: Who played at the H&J
summary: He recalls the drummer Jacques, who played bones, and a trumpeter with a cataract.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Oh, who was at the H&J with Cornbread, you said?
I was with Cornbread at the H&J. What year did you say?
No, who was there other than you and Cornbread?
Um, I remember it's not so great, but, uh, I remember, uh, old drummer they called, uh, Jill. He used to play Bones. He was one of the old times, he used to play Bones.

Jacques, yeah, that's right. Jacques. I remember Jacques, I remember, uh, a trumpet player he had with him, with a boy, a cataract on his eye. I always wonder what happened to that boy, he was a good trumpet man.
Yeah, cataract on his eyes. Yeah, he played with a better call for you. Yeah.
